offlineProtection.explainerLead: During service your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) must be on and online.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen goes off, the device loses internet, or you switch to another website, offline protection takes over — as you chose, it pauses orders or turns auto-accept off.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Keep your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) on and online during service, otherwise offline protection may take over.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection switched on.

To keep orders coming, your screen must stay on. If this device loses its connection, offline protection takes over in the way you chose.

Make sure “Screen on” is switched on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses its connection, online orders keep coming — customers may place orders you cannot see. Only switch it off if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders when your device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses its connection, this stops orders arriving while you cannot see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this vehicle loses its connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online orders
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers cannot order until you are back online.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep taking orders, confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is switched off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. When you are back online you confirm them one by one — any order still waiting after your chosen time is rejected automatically, and the customer is told by email.
offlineProtection.autoRejectLabel: Reject orders waiting longer than this
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can produce at once, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top of that.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set “Total capacity” to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the “Starters” and “Mains” boxes. Your mains will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave it at the infinity symbol for no limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them, capacity cannot know how long items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Add a vehicle in Settings › Vehicle settings to set your kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make — so customers can only choose collection times you can meet.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: Same kitchen capacity for all vehicles?
kitchenCapacity.confirmBody: All vehicles will use this vehicle’s kitchen capacity: {van}. Each vehicle’s own numbers will be replaced.
kitchenCapacity.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward total capacity. Cooked categories always count; tick instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
kitchenCapacity.countsLocked: Cooked category — always counts (its prep time and batch set the pace)
kitchenCapacity.countsNoCap: Set a capacity to choose which categories count
kitchenCapacity.countsUnavailable: Unavailable until the database is updated
kitchenCapacity.countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared limit for each time window
kitchenCapacity.setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity to choose which categories count.
kitchenCapacity.categoryBatchAria: {hasCategory, select, yes {Items per batch — {category}} other {Items per batch}}
kitchenCapacity.prepPerOrderHelp: How long one order takes to prepare
kitchenCapacity.itemsAtATimeHelp: How many items your kitchen can cook at the same time
kitchenCapacity.instantNote: Instant items do not count toward kitchen capacity — customers get them immediately.
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Let customers cancel orders
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel until <select></select> before their collection time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders confirm automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next available slot. Only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still have to be confirmed by you.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order-ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately, on each device. Customers get an email whenever an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still switch it on or off for a single event from its dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you hand out buzzers for collection?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record which buzzer you gave each customer, so you know who to look for when their food is ready.
settingsCopy.buzzers.countLabel: How many buzzers do you have?
whereYouTrade.stepHeading: Where is your food truck based?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country cannot be changed later, because it is tied to your card payments.
whereYouTrade.countryGuessed: We guessed this from where you are. Change it if it is wrong.
whereYouTrade.townQuestion: The town you are based in
whereYouTrade.saveFailed: Could not save settings — please try again.
stockCopy.defaultScopeNote: The default for every event. To set a different amount for one event, change it on that event’s dashboard — events you already set there keep their own amount.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.perDishBod: Review every dish and confirm its allergens. Customers see per-dish tags plus an allergen summary card made from them.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.cardBody: Upload or paste a single allergen card (PDF, image or text); it is shown as it is. Per-dish tags stay hidden.

manageSettings.getApp.title: Get the app
manageSettings.getApp.body: The kitchen app runs your service on a phone or tablet — it is the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal. Free with your account, on iPhone, iPad and Android.

manageSettings.schedule.title: Your schedule
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we will check it for you, sending any events we find for your approval. This must be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events listed elsewhere, we will still send them for your approval. Nothing goes live until you confirm it.
manageSettings.schedule.wherePost: Where do you post your schedule?
manageSettings.schedule.checkingHelp: This can take up to 2 minutes — please keep this page open and do not close the tab.
manageSettings.schedule.urlHelp: Your website where customers can see your upcoming events — not a Facebook or Instagram page
manageSettings.schedule.exclusionsHelp: These words are filtered out automatically when your schedule is imported. Remove any that were added by mistake.

manageSettings.qr.domainNotLive: This QR code sends customers to your HatchGrab ordering page. If you later set up your own web address, the same QR code will send them there instead — you will not need to print a new one.
